card.name: The N ending ULN before bilirubin
card.fires_on: The final letter N of ULN (upper limit of normal) in liver-test stopping rules, right before "with/and bilirubin". Weaker on a few other words that precede "with" or "or" clauses, such as "elevation" and "acuity".

modes.label: ULN in liver rules
modes.description: The N closing ULN after a multiplier like 3 x, in ALT/AST thresholds paired with bilirubin.
modes.example: or ALT or AST >3 × UL<<N>> with bilirubin >2 ×

modes.label: Symptom term before a joining word
modes.description: A noun that ends a symptom phrase and is followed by "with" or "or".
modes.example: Any Grade CPK<< elevation>> with symptoms or with renal impairment Withhold
